definition: DeepL is a German AI research company known for its language AI platform, which includes DeepL Translator and DeepL Voice, and for DeepL Agent, an AI agent capable of planning workflows and using office systems and tools autonomously, in response to natural language instructions.
details: Its algorithm uses the transformer architecture. It offers a paid subscription for additional features and access to its translation application programming interface. DeepL was founded in 2017 by Jaroslaw Kutylowski and is a unicorn, valued at $2 billion after a Series C funding round raised $300 million in May 2024. Its more than 200,000 business customers include a large proportion of the Fortune 500.

explainer.lead: DeepL Translator is an AI translation tool made by the German company DeepL. It turns text from one language into another using the transformer architecture, with paid subscriptions adding features and access to its translation API.

tiers.eli5: DeepL Translator is like a digital language helper: you give it a sentence in one language, and it writes that sentence in another. It uses an AI system called a transformer to work out the translation.
tiers.practitioner: Developers can integrate DeepL's translation API into software, with API access available through a paid subscription. Additional product features are also part of the paid offering.
tiers.paperLevel: DeepL Translator implements a learned mapping f_theta: source text -> target text, using the transformer architecture. It is a translation tool within DeepL's language AI platform.

explainer.example: A user enters the English sentence "Where is the train station?" and selects German as the target language; DeepL Translator returns a German translation of that sentence.

usedIn.name: Business translation
usedIn.detail: DeepL has more than 200,000 business customers, including a large proportion of the Fortune 500.

usedIn.name: Software integrations
usedIn.detail: Paid subscribers can access DeepL's translation application programming interface.

explainer.intuition: The tool takes meaning expressed in one language and produces corresponding text in another. Its transformer-based algorithm handles the translation automatically.
howItWorks: Provide text in a source language.
DeepL Translator processes the text with its transformer-based algorithm.
The tool generates text in the target language.
Users needing additional features or API access can use a paid subscription.
explainer.whyItMatters: It makes AI translation available both directly to users and through an API for businesses and software products.
misconceptions: DeepL Translator is a tool; DeepL is the company and broader language AI platform behind it.
API access and additional features are tied to a paid subscription.

diagram.caption: DeepL Translator uses a transformer-based algorithm to turn source text into translated text.
